questions.q: Where in Setup do you start building a new custom app?
options: App Manager, via the "New Lightning App" button
questions.explain: App Manager's "New Lightning App" button launches the four-stage custom app wizard.

questions.q: Which wizard stage actually decides which tabs ship inside the finished app?
questions.explain: Navigation Items is where tabs move from Available Items to Selected Items, becoming the app's tab bar in that order.

questions.q: What determines the order tabs appear in a custom app's nav bar?
options: The order the underlying objects were created
Tabs appear in random order and cannot be controlled
The order items are listed in Selected Items on the Navigation Items screen
questions.explain: The Selected Items list order on the Navigation Items screen is exactly the order users see in the live app.

questions.q: After saving the New Lightning App wizard, what has to happen before users can find the app?
options: Nothing — it's immediately visible and searchable in the App Launcher
A separate deployment or publish step
An Apex deploy via change set
questions.explain: There's no separate publish step — saving the wizard makes the app live and searchable in the App Launcher right away.

questions.q: Which wizard stage controls who is even allowed to open the app?
questions.explain: The User Profiles stage sets which profiles can see and open the new app.
